disposition_reason: Besides method validation, Table 6 prints total arsenic, extractable As(III) and As(V) and non-extractable arsenic for ten retail chicken and turkey breast and thigh samples from Trinidad and Tobago; Table 7 prints arsenic in the methanol extract for four.

study.design: Analytical method paper (solvent extraction with selective-reduction HG-AAS) applied to ten retail poultry samples
study.market: Poultry depots and retail supermarkets in various parts of Trinidad and Tobago
study.method: Soxhlet extraction with 30:70 methanol-water (6 h, 78 °C); As(III) and As(V) by selective-reduction hydride generation AAS; residue and whole sample digested with HNO3 for non-extractable and total arsenic
study.lod_text: Tables 6-7: LOD/LOQ As(III) 0.525/1.75, As(V) 2.88/9.60, oAs 1.41/4.70, tAs 2.47/8.23 µg/kg; Tables 2 and 4: LOD/LOQ tAs 0.261/0.870 mg/kg, iAs 0.003/0.010 mg/kg
study.qa: DORM-5 fish protein CRM: tAs 13.1 vs 13.3 mg/kg (98.9%), iAs 93.8%, oAs 95.5%; spike recoveries As(III) 93.3-105%, As(V) 93.9-105%; sum of species vs tAs 91.8-106%

unresolved: Two different tAs LOD/LOQ sets are printed: 0.261/0.870 mg/kg (Tables 2 and 4) and 2.47/8.23 µg/kg (Tables 6-7). The low-concentration sample results are only valid against the second set.
Several As(V) values (5.72, 5.46 µg/kg) and one Table 7 total are printed as numbers although below the stated LOQ; flagged.
Retail brand names in Tables 5-7 replaced with brand A-E; the 'thigh' of brand D is not stated to be turkey or chicken.
Sum of species (ΣAs) and % accuracy columns in Table 6 are derived values and were not extracted; inorganic arsenic (As(III)+As(V)) per sample is not printed in Table 6 and was not computed.
Table 5 (spiked recoveries) original values differ slightly from Table 6 (e.g. brand C breast As(V) 442 vs 441; brand C thigh As(III) 258 vs 257; brand B thigh As(V) <LOQ vs 5.72 µg/kg).
Text calls the spiking matrix 'Arsenic free' organic chicken breast yet states a total inorganic arsenic of 50 µg/kg after adding 30 µg/kg.
Number of samples per product and collection dates are not reported.
